answer: A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The mirror counter is kept in nadir and atlas publishes each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1987 identities would post 4888 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
